scope: One conditional genuine parent-only turret neural forward using the exact reviewed candidate, after its publication. No retry, alternate precision/backend/resolution, extraction, sampling, build or repair is admitted.

runtime_CPU_tests.coverage: Selective BF16/F32 policy, full input contract, actual CPU output writer, production native argument/phase/restoration controls with metadata-only inputs, and tensor traceback-release regression. These are not GPU convolution experiments.

admission_CPU_tests.coverage: Source-aware callback order, bounds, cache/row/width validation, authentic mask child counting and pre-operation refusals.

Phase_A.source_match: The captured reference calls blocks.float(), converts only MIX_PRECISION_MODULES to BF16, sets decoder.dtype=BF16 and feeds F32. The pinned local parent uses F32 from_latent/output_layer and LayerNorm32 with F32 normalization followed by the incoming feature dtype. The candidate applies the same selective policy after unchanged strict loading.
Phase_A.strict_checkpoint_first: All 292 original F16 entries and the existing 76 byte-exact F32 widenings are verified before runtime conversion. Existing ShapeDecoderComponent and StrictLocalComponent remain unchanged.
Phase_A.runtime_conversion: Exactly the 216 previously F16 block parameters become BF16, with every change recorded including the F32 intermediate and BF16 rounding. All 76 sensitive F32 tensors, parameter names/shapes and eval/gradient state are preserved. BF16 conversion is not described as lossless checkpoint widening.
Phase_A.algorithm: The actual Trellis conv configuration and FlexGEMM global both use explicit_gemm; hashmap ratio remains 2.0. Local conv_flex_gemm reapplies the root settings each convolution. FlexGEMM Triton allow_tf32 and Torch TF32 flags are false.
Phase_A.source_guards: All seven decisive local source hashes in the reference policy match and are covered by the existing 97-file guest source guard.
Phase_A.reference_limit: This verifies a matching source policy, not numerical parity or successful BF16/native execution. The reference itself reports nonfinite output risk; this candidate requires finite completed neural output.

Phase_B.conv_checks: Before each original callback, validate real support rows, BF16 width/weights, I32 coordinates, kernel/stride/dilation, sequence and real cached neighbor-map layout. Bound full im2col, masked gather, long indices, mask, hash/map, output and downstream original block buffers against current live allocation/reservation and device free memory.
Phase_B.C2S_checks: Count children from the genuine boolean learned mask before the original nonzero/repeat/coordinate/gather allocations. Check exact shared mask and parent support on both original calls; budget feature and skip expansions, geometry temporaries, skip repeat and downstream norm/activation/residual buffers.
Phase_B.boundary_checks: Placement admission includes model bytes, full authentic input, initial F32 projection and cast. The preceding same-row/width ConvNeXt downstream allowance covers the up-block to_subdiv/norm/SiLU prefix. The final conv2 allowance covers the original F32 cast/norm/seven-channel projection.
Phase_B.actual_cache_API_matches: Pinned SparseConv3d uses the checked 3-tuples, (Co,3,3,3,Ci) weight layout and exact cache key; the wheel cache object exposes neighbor_map. Both C2S calls have fresh learned-mask handling rather than a cached replacement.
Phase_B.opaque_allocation_limit: The visible source budgets, extra headroom and allocator ceiling are practical admission controls. They do not mathematically bound undocumented native HIP/BLAS allocations or guarantee against device faults; external containment and monitoring remain required.

Phase_C.input: Unmodified, hash-verified denormalized F32 [3743,32] and I32 [3743,4], with original row order and fresh spatial cache.
Phase_C.forward: Call the genuine SparseUnetVaeDecoder.forward(model,x,guide_subs=None,return_subs=True) exactly once under inference mode and eval/disabled gradients. low_vram selects only the pinned original implementation's chunking; admission does not assume that flag alone bounds memory.
Phase_C.native_boundary: Only original hashmap_build_submanifold_conv_neighbour_map is admitted, inside an admitted active convolution. Require exact 12 arguments, tensor identity/device/dtypes/contiguity/hash sizing/spatial/kernel/dilation values, explicit algorithm and default stream. Reject repeated native calls at a site, all other bindings and foreign native/profile entries.
Phase_C.compilation_policy: Existing compiler/JIT/autotune/runtime guards and process/network/filesystem audit remain installed after import/CPU tensor guards end. No compilation, tuning miss, algorithm fallback or retry is admitted.
Phase_C.containment: Reuse the exact GO handshake, Windows Job attach before GO, continuous healthy device/system-event monitoring, host RAM/D-disk polls, guest timeout and named Modly distro termination. Require unforced owned-tree cleanup and a healthy post-exit observation for reliable acceptance.
Phase_C.output_acceptance: Require all 40 convs and eight C2S calls; genuine F32 [N,7] output/I32 coordinates, four BF16 subdivision outputs with source-consistent support/mask linkage, valid coordinate ranges/unique support and numerical finiteness. Save the ten original CPU tensors to a fresh local artifact directory outside Git, cap payload at 256MiB/header at 128KiB, verify readback including raw tensor hashes, and record file/tensor SHA256 plus provenance.
Phase_C.release: Remove callback/profile/native wrappers, clear original spatial caches and tensor locals, collect input/output and model/component/parameter weak references, synchronize, clear the BLAS workspace exactly once and empty allocator cache. Require allocated/reserved GPU bytes zero; cleanup failures remain unqualified.

resolved_findings.finding: An active failure traceback retained genuine forward/hook tensor frames and could mask AdmissionStop with a weakref error.
resolved_findings.resolution: Production detach_failure stores original type/message/formatted traceback, clears the traceback, then cleanup checks references and rethrows a new exception preserving the stop class. A focused actual CPU-tensor regression passes.

resolved_findings.finding: The copied newE resource record retained obsolete CPU-only total deadlines.
resolved_findings.resolution: The newE record now states the actual 60/120/240/450/430/480 deadlines and labels the inherited CPU memory/hash timing basis.

conditions_before_the_one_attempt: Publish and verify this exact candidate and review before reserving the marker; the host entry requires the exact published HEAD and candidate identity manifest.

All live worker identity, source/payload, GPU/RAM/disk and per-operation gates must pass. A refusal or runtime error ends this route with its original boundary evidence; no repair/retry/fallback follows.
The root task owns the sole runtime attempt and final decision from actual measurements; this GO is preparation approval, not evidence that neural output already exists.
